Ensuring you stay on the right track to graduate on time is crucial. Meeting with your Academic Advisor will make this journey smoother.

New Undergraduate Students (Admitted Spring 2027)

Brand new to New York Tech? Advising appointments begin November 19, 2026. Check your Admissions Portal for next steps.

Continuing Undergraduate Students

To check your assigned advisor, log in to your Engage Student Success Portal. From there, you will find the option to “Meet with Me” or “Email Me” to schedule a meeting.

Make An Appointment

If you don’t see an assigned advisor, find them from the options below.

Graduate Students

If you don’t see your advisor below log into your Student Service HUB, go to Academics, then select Engage Student Success.

If you have an assigned advisor, you will see an option to meet with them or send them an email to request an appointment. If you haven’t been assigned an advisor yet, scroll down and find the contact information for advisors and program chairpersons. Feel free to get in touch with them directly for help.
